title: Back Market
bio: Back Market is a French online marketplace selling refurbished smartphones, laptops, tablets and other electronics from professional sellers.

title: Baemin
bio: South Korean food delivery app run by Woowa Brothers for ordering restaurant meals, groceries and convenience goods.

title: BambooHR
bio: BambooHR provides HR software for small and medium-sized businesses, covering employee records, hiring, onboarding, time off and payroll.

title: Bayt
bio: Bayt.com is an online job site serving the Middle East and North Africa, connecting job seekers with employers across the region.

title: Bayut
bio: Bayut is a UAE property portal listing apartments, villas and commercial properties for sale and rent.

title: Betterment
bio: Betterment is a robo-adviser that builds and manages diversified investment portfolios automatically, and also offers retirement and cash accounts.

title: BharatPe
bio: BharatPe provides QR code payments, card machines and business loans for merchants and small shopkeepers in India.

title: Bird
bio: Micromobility company renting shared electric scooters and e-bikes through its app in cities in North America and Europe.

title: Bitdefender
bio: Bitdefender makes antivirus and cybersecurity software for consumers and businesses, including endpoint protection and threat detection services.

title: bitFlyer
bio: bitFlyer is a Japanese cryptocurrency exchange that lets users buy, sell and trade bitcoin and other digital assets.

title: Bithumb
bio: Bithumb is a South Korean cryptocurrency exchange offering trading of digital assets against the Korean won.

title: Bitpanda
bio: Bitpanda is an Austrian investment platform where users can buy and sell cryptocurrencies, precious metals and other assets.

title: Bitso
bio: Bitso is a Latin American cryptocurrency platform for buying, selling and holding digital assets and making cross-border transfers.

title: Bitvavo
bio: Bitvavo is a Dutch cryptocurrency exchange that lets European users buy, sell and store digital assets with euros.

title: BlaBlaCar
bio: French carpooling and bus platform for long-distance travel.

title: Bluesky
bio: Decentralized social network for short posts built on the open AT Protocol, with customizable feeds and moderation.

title: boAt
bio: boAt sells wireless earbuds, headphones, speakers and smartwatches aimed at Indian consumers.
